[[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]Date established in narrative text. |series=''[[Star Wars Science Adventures]]'' |preceded by=[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four|''Emergency in Escape Pod Four'']] |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars Science Adventures: Journey Across Planet X''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] junior novel written by [[Jude Watson]] and [[K.D. Burkett]], with interior art by [[Frank Boyd Forney]]. It is the second installment of the book series ''[[Star Wars Science Adventures]]'', and it was published in [[February]] [[1999]] by [[Scholastic]]. The book is set in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], and it follows young [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Stuart Zissu]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[4B-X]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] as they journey across a strange planet, using science to find rescue. ''Journey Across Planet X'' did not receive a sequel, and its story was left unresolved.
